# 🧩 opencode-skills-tui

English | 简体中文

Browse skills, track loaded state, preview SKILL.md, and insert skill attachments from the [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) terminal sidebar. ![Skills panel demo](assets/demo.gif) ## 📦 Install / update / remove Requires **OpenCode ≥ 2.0**. Terminal UI (TUI) only. ```bash opencode plugin add opencode-skills-tui ``` - Update: `opencode plugin update opencode-skills-tui` - Remove: `opencode plugin remove opencode-skills-tui` On V1, see the [V1 guide](https://github.com/aihaipeng/opencode-skills-tui/blob/v0.4.4/README.md). ## ⚙️ Parameters Run `/skills-sidebar` to open the settings panel. | Setting | Description | Available values | | --- | --- | --- | | Show sidebar | Show or hide the panel | `on` / `off` | | Display scope | Choose which skills to show (see below) | `model-visible` / `registered` / `loaded-only` | | Token estimation | Show static token estimates | `list entry` / `load cost` / `total cost` / `off` | | Header counts | Show skill counts in the header | `on` / `off` | | Skill overview | Choose the mouse button for a read-only preview | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Insert @mention | Choose the mouse button for inserting a native skill attachment into the prompt | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | - **Display scope:** - `model-visible`: skills the model can discover and invoke automatically. - `loaded-only`: only skills successfully loaded in the current stage, including hidden skills. - `registered`: all skills registered for the host's current directory, including hidden skills. **Hidden skills:** omitted from the model's available list by metadata or permission rules, **not offered for automatic discovery/invocation**, but can be explicitly loaded with `@skill-id`. Hidden does not mean loading is disabled. Every scope retains current-stage loaded IDs. Loaded skills, including hidden ones, are pinned to the top. Automatic invocation still follows the host's permission rules. Display scope does not change permissions, and hiding the panel does not disable skills. - **Sidebar colors:** | Item | Color | | --- | --- | | Skills title and expand/collapse arrow | White in dark mode; black in light mode | | Unloaded, model-visible skill names and bullets | White in dark mode; black in light mode | | Loaded skill names and bullets, including hidden skills | Theme selection highlight | | Unloaded hidden skills, header counts, and token estimates | Theme muted color | Colors update when the active mode or theme changes. Unloaded model-visible skills do not use the theme's body text color, which can resemble the loaded highlight in themes such as `tokyonight light`. - **Token estimation:** - `list entry`: estimated tokens for a model-visible listing entry (ID, name, description), without the skill body; hidden entries cost `0`. - `load cost`: estimated additional tokens for one ordinary load, including the body and host-added information. - `total cost`: per-skill `list entry + load cost`, regardless of whether the skill is currently loaded. These are static estimates, not live context usage, cumulative consumption or billing; unavailable values show `-`. Settings persist across sessions and restarts and sync across local TUI instances; collapse stays per-terminal. ## 💡 Notes - **Unloaded after compaction:** OpenCode's context compaction (`/compact`) is [lossy](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/compaction/) and does not guarantee continued adherence to skill instructions. Successful compaction resets load marks; a new successful load highlights the skill again. `loaded` counts distinct successfully loaded skills since session start or the latest successful compaction, not invocations. Unloaded does not mean all skill text is absent from context. - **Preview:** locally readable SKILL.md takes priority; otherwise the host's registered body is shown. Preview text may differ from model input. Colors follow the active theme, including changes while the preview is open; Markdown styling, text selection, and copying are preserved. Ctrl+click rendered HTTP(S) links to open them in your browser. ## 📁 Source structure ```text opencode-skills-tui/ ├── src/ │ ├── tui.tsx # Plugin setup, preview, and native skill attachments │ ├── skill-data.ts # Skill visibility, load state, and token estimates │ ├── open-link.ts # Ctrl+click link opening │ └── components/ │ ├── skills-panel.tsx # Sidebar panel │ └── skills-dialog.tsx # Sidebar settings dialog ├── scripts/ # Build and package validation ├── test/ # Regression tests ├── assets/ # Demo media ├── dist/ # Generated TUI bundle ├── index.ts # Required no-op server entry └── tui.tsx # Forwards to the compiled TUI bundle ``` ## 🛠️ Local development In a local checkout, use [Bun](https://bun.sh): ```bash bun install bun run build bun run test ``` Replace the npm entry with the checkout's absolute `file://` URL in the existing `plugins` array in `opencode.json(c)`. Rebuild and restart the TUI after code changes. [OpenCode plugin docs](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/plugins) · [MIT license](LICENSE)

# 🧩 opencode-skills-tui

English | 简体中文

在 [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) 终端侧栏查看技能及加载状态、预览 SKILL.md，并插入技能附件。 ![技能面板演示](assets/demo.gif) ## 📦 安装／更新／卸载 要求 **OpenCode ≥ 2.0**，仅适用于终端界面（TUI）。 ```bash #安装/更新/卸载 opencode plugin add/update/remove opencode-skills-tui ``` 执行时将 `add/update/remove` 替换为所需子命令。 V1 用户请参考 [V1 说明](https://github.com/aihaipeng/opencode-skills-tui/blob/v0.4.4/README.zh-CN.md)。 ## ⚙️ 参数说明 运行 `/skills-sidebar` 打开设置面板。 | 设置 | 简要说明 | 可选参数 | | --- | --- | --- | | Show sidebar | 显示／隐藏面板 | `on` / `off` | | Display scope | 选择技能显示范围（见下方说明） | `model-visible` / `registered` / `loaded-only` | | Token estimation | 显示静态 token 估值 | `list entry` / `load cost` / `total cost` / `off` | | Header counts | 显示标题中的技能数量 | `on` / `off` | | Skill overview | 选择打开只读预览的鼠标键 | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | | Insert @mention | 选择向输入框插入原生技能附件的鼠标键 | `left-click` / `middle-click` / `right-click` / `off` | - **Display scope**： - `model-visible`：模型可发现并自动调用的技能。 - `loaded-only`：仅显示当前阶段成功加载的技能，包括隐藏技能。 - `registered`：宿主当前目录的全部已注册技能，包括隐藏技能。 **隐藏技能**：因元数据或权限规则未进入模型可用清单，**不供模型自动发现／调用**，但可通过 `@skill-id` 显式加载；隐藏不等于禁止加载。 各范围均保留当前阶段已加载的 ID，已加载技能（包括隐藏技能）置顶。自动调用仍遵循宿主权限规则；显示范围不修改权限，隐藏面板不会禁用技能。 - **侧栏配色**： | 项目 | 颜色 | | --- | --- | | Skills 标题与展开／折叠箭头 | dark 白色，light 黑色 | | 未加载、模型可见的技能名称与圆点 | dark 白色，light 黑色 | | 已加载技能的名称与圆点，包括隐藏技能 | 主题选中高亮色 | | 未加载的隐藏技能、标题计数与 token 估值 | 主题灰色（muted） | 切换模式或主题时颜色同步更新。未加载且模型可见的技能不使用主题正文色，避免在 `tokyonight light` 等主题中与已加载高亮过于接近。 - **Token estimation**： - `list entry`：模型可见清单条目（ID、名称、描述）的预计 token，不含技能正文；隐藏项为 `0`。 - `load cost`：一次普通加载预计新增的 token，包含正文及宿主附加信息。 - `total cost`：单技能的 `list entry + load cost`，与当前是否已加载无关。 均为静态估值，不是实时上下文占用、累计消耗或计费量；未知值显示 `-`。 设置跨会话和重启保留，并在本地 TUI 实例间同步；折叠状态仅属于当前终端。 ## 💡 注意事项 - **压缩后显示未加载**：OpenCode 的上下文压缩（`/compact`，Compaction）是[有损压缩](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/compaction/)，不保证模型在压缩后持续遵循技能。因此插件在压缩成功后重置加载标记，重新成功加载才再次高亮。`loaded` 统计会话开始或最近一次成功压缩后加载成功的不同技能数，不是调用次数；未加载不代表上下文中已没有技能文本。 - **预览**：优先读取本地可读的 SKILL.md，否则展示宿主注册正文；内容可能不同于模型输入。配色随当前主题更新，包括预览打开期间的主题切换；保留 Markdown 样式、文字选择和复制。Ctrl+点击已渲染的 HTTP(S) 链接可在浏览器中打开。 ## 📁 源码结构 ```text opencode-skills-tui/ ├── src/ │ ├── tui.tsx # 插件注册、预览及原生技能附件 │ ├── skill-data.ts # 技能可见性、加载状态及 token 估值 │ ├── open-link.ts # Ctrl+点击打开链接 │ └── components/ │ ├── skills-panel.tsx # 侧栏面板 │ └── skills-dialog.tsx # 侧栏设置弹窗 ├── scripts/ # 构建及打包校验 ├── test/ # 回归测试 ├── assets/ # 演示素材 ├── dist/ # 生成的 TUI 构建产物 ├── index.ts # 宿主要求的空操作 server 入口 └── tui.tsx # 转出预编译 TUI 的包入口 ``` ## 🛠️ 本地开发 在本地仓库中使用 [Bun](https://bun.sh)： ```bash bun install bun run build bun run test ``` 在 `opencode.json(c)` 现有的 `plugins` 数组中，用仓库的绝对 `file://` URL 替代 npm 条目。修改代码后重新构建并重启 TUI。 [OpenCode 插件文档](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/plugins) · [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)
